description: Retrieves a Salesforce contact by ID, optionally requesting selected fields. The response is limited to fields represented by the tool's response schema.

contact_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the contact to retrieve. Must be a valid 18-character Salesforce ID; names or emails are not valid substitutes.
contact_id.human_parameter_description: The unique Salesforce ID of the contact you want to retrieve. Paste it from the contact's URL or use an ID from a previous search.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

fields.description: Comma-delimited string of Contact field API names to retrieve. If omitted, all fields are returned.
fields.human_parameter_description: Which contact details you want returned. Provide a comma-separated list of field names (like Name, Email, Phone) to get only those fields; leave blank to retrieve all fields.
fields.title: Fields
